# 2 Clement — Chapter 4 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 4
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. We must not just call him "Lord" and leave it there — that alone will not save us.
2. He himself said: "Not everyone who calls me 'Lord, Lord' will be saved — only the one who lives rightly."
3. So, brothers and sisters, let our actions be the way we confess him: by loving one another, by remaining faithful in our marriages, by not tearing others down with our words, by not being driven by jealousy — instead being self-controlled, compassionate, and genuinely good. We ought to care for one another and not be greedy.
4. It is by living this way that we confess him — not by doing the opposite.
5. We should not fear other people; we should fear God.
6. That is why the Lord has warned us: "Even if you were gathered right against my chest — if you did not keep my commandments, I would throw you out and tell you: Get away from me. I don't know where you come from, you who practice lawlessness."
